description: The University of Cádiz research group publishes voltage-disturbance events detected in its instrumentation and industrial-electronics laboratory during 2021. Twelve monthly tables report voltage magnitude as a percentage of nominal voltage and disturbance duration in seconds. Harvard Dataverse exposes the named record and file metadata through its public API, with CSV and tab-separated representations under CC0. The dataset is free to reuse for power-quality simulations, event-frequency assumptions or comparison against equipment-acceptability curves. It covers one laboratory supply, not a distribution network, so broader reliability inference is limited. The deposit lists observations only; the article’s Python and MATLAB workflow is not assumed to be included. File payloads were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Replication Data for: Methodology for the Surveillance the Voltage Supply in Public Buildings Using the ITIC Curve and Python Programming
notes: G4-0459; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
